# Kelp: five mint segments zig-zagging up 2.4 m, two leaves. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Kelp --base-color 0.447 0.863 0.733 --no-slot
material new Stem --base-color 0.204 0.675 0.729 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Seg0 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.250 --rotation 0 12 0
scale 0.140 0.100 0.520
apply --scale
material assign Stem
add mesh cube --name Seg1 --size 1 --location 0.100 0.000 0.730 --rotation 0 -12 0
scale 0.140 0.100 0.520
apply --scale
material assign Kelp
add mesh cube --name Seg2 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 1.210 --rotation 0 12 0
scale 0.140 0.100 0.520
apply --scale
material assign Stem
add mesh cube --name Seg3 --size 1 --location 0.100 0.000 1.690 --rotation 0 -12 0
scale 0.140 0.100 0.520
apply --scale
material assign Kelp
add mesh cube --name Seg4 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 2.170 --rotation 0 12 0
scale 0.140 0.100 0.520
apply --scale
material assign Stem
add mesh cube --name LeafA --size 1 --location 0.220 0.000 1.000 --rotation 0 -30 0
scale 0.360 0.060 0.160
apply --scale
material assign Kelp
add mesh cube --name LeafB --size 1 --location -0.200 0.000 1.750 --rotation 0 30 0
scale 0.340 0.060 0.150
apply --scale
material assign Kelp
select all
shade flat
export kelp.glb
